ecosystem.title: Ethereum <accent>Ecosystem</accent> Map
ecosystem.description: Key services and tools across Ethereum, from L2s and DeFi to clients, research and privacy.

tools.arbitrum: Optimistic rollup L2 with Arbitrum One and Orbit chains
tools.optimism: Optimistic rollup behind the OP Stack and the Superchain

tools.eigenlayer: Restaking that reuses staked ETH to secure other services

tools.beaconchain: Beacon chain validator and staking dashboard
tools.dune: On-chain data analytics and custom dashboards

tools.growthepie: Usage and fee metrics for Ethereum L2s
tools.ultrasound: Real-time ETH issuance, burn and supply tracker
tools.ethereumAdoption: Database of enterprise and institutional Ethereum adoption
tools.reth: Execution client written in Rust by Paradigm
tools.lighthouse: Consensus client written in Rust by Sigma Prime
tools.prysm: Consensus client written in Go by Offchain Labs
tools.teku: Consensus client written in Java by Consensys
tools.nimbus: Lightweight consensus client written in Nim

tools.clientDiversity: Client market share and diversity tracker
